description: Held-out evaluation tasks for future base-vs-finetuned comparisons. These tasks are not training data.

tasks.prompt: In the project profile fixture, update the status line from draft to ready for held-out evaluation. Make the smallest correct edit and return a final answer after the verifier condition is satisfied.
tasks.expected_artifact: PROFILE.md status says ready for held-out evaluation
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('PROFILE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Status: ready for held-out evaluation' in text; assert 'Status: draft' not in text"

tasks.prompt: Fix average so it returns the arithmetic mean for single-item and multi-item lists while still rejecting empty lists. Inspect the implementation and tests, make the smallest correct code change, then verify with the test suite.
tasks.expected_artifact: stats.py divides by the number of values when computing average
